tools.name: create_google_calendar_event
tools.description: Creates a new event on a Google Calendar with a title, start and end time, and optional attendees. Returns the event ID and link.

params.name: calendar_id
params.description: ID of the calendar to add the event to

tools.name: get_calendly_scheduled_events
tools.description: Lists upcoming scheduled Calendly events for a user within a date range. Returns event names, start times and status.

params.name: min_start_time
params.description: ISO 8601 lower bound for event start

params.name: max_start_time
params.description: ISO 8601 upper bound for event start

tools.name: cancel_caldav_appointment
tools.description: Deletes an appointment from a CalDAV calendar server by its event UID.

params.name: calendar_url
params.description: URL of the CalDAV calendar collection

params.name: event_uid
params.description: UID of the event to delete
